items.description: SC-D1: AI-use disclosure (26_ A3-A10): the Acknowledgments paragraph omits Opus 5 among the model labels, dates the use from September (the training and architecture code was written in August), omits the simulation, data-generation and training code and the assistant's running of the pipeline, omits the literature search, attributes the writing of the preregistration and both addenda to the authors (they were drafted by the assistant and decided/approved by the authors), says the authors 'made every design decision' (some were taken by the assistant under prior authorisation and approved), says the authors re-derived every number (the re-derivation was a separate checking script), and its last sentence ('No figure was generated by an AI tool') contradicts the preceding statement that the assistant wrote the figure scripts. Replace with the 26_ §6.1 paragraph.
